meta.description: Talk to data APIs in plain English with Raynard.

hero.title: The AI analyst that cites its sources
hero.body: Raynard connects to data APIs so you can ask questions in plain English—every number comes back with a reference you can check.
hero.demoLabel: Product demo — cited answers from live API data

features.title: Built for analysts who need proof

cards.title: Cited answers
cards.body: Every figure Raynard gives you links back to the API response and source reference it came from.

cards.title: Connect anything
cards.body: Send Raynard a link to an API’s docs and it can build the connection for you—no config files.

cards.title: Plain English, real numbers
cards.body: Ask questions the way you would ask a colleague. Get grounded numbers, not guesses.

cards.title: Native to your Mac
cards.body: A real desktop app that keeps conversations, connections, and credentials under your control.

items.title: Create your own extension with one prompt
items.prompt: Please add World Bank data for me to chat with, it's at data360.worldbank.org/en/api
bullets: Builds and tests an API connector with just a prompt
The agent will have access to this data source in future chats
Share your connector with the community or keep it private on your own machine

items.title: Get data-backed analysis with references
items.prompt: How does Britain's productivity compare with the EU and why?
items.body: The agent can interrogate multiple APIs and to build confidence it cites the results directly.
bullets: Returns the matching records with source links
Keeps the supporting API response with the result

items.title: Surface inventory below target
items.prompt: Show me warehouse inventory turns below target this month.
items.body: A generated inventory plugin can compare current records with the target thresholds exposed by its API.
bullets: Returns the affected SKUs with supporting references
Reruns against current data when thresholds change

howItWorks.title: From question to receipt in three steps

steps.title: Point it at your data
steps.body: Paste a link to an API’s docs or request a data source. Raynard sets up the extension after you approve it.

steps.title: Ask in plain English
steps.body: No query language and no dashboard to build. Just type the question you actually have.

steps.title: Get answers with receipts
steps.body: Every number retains its source, so you can double-check the evidence before you rely on it.

cta.title: Ready to talk data?
cta.body: Connect your sources and start asking questions.
